name: Lux
title: the Lady of Luminosity

Q.name: Light Binding
Q.description: Lux fires a ball of light, Rooting the first two enemies for 2 seconds and dealing 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.75×AP magic damage to each.
Q.summary: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

W.name: Prismatic Barrier
W.description: Lux throws her wand, granting 40/55/70/85/100 + 0.4×AP Shield for 2.5 seconds to allies it passes through. Then it returns, granting the same Shield on its return.
W.summary: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

E.name: Lucent Singularity
E.description: Lux creates a light zone that Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% and reveals the area. After 5 seconds or on Recasting this Ability, it detonates, dealing 65/115/165/215/265 + 0.8×AP magic damage and Slowing for an additional 1 second.
E.summary: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

R.name: Final Spark
R.description: Lux fires a dazzling ray of light, dealing 300/400/500 + 1.2×AP magic damage to all enemies in a line.
R.summary: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

Passive.name: Illumination
Passive.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.
Passive.summary: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Lux is a long-range mage who roots with Light Binding and finishes targets with Final Spark. She plays mid or support, poking from far away and punishing anyone who walks into her skillshots.
strengths: Light Binding roots the first two enemies for a long time, enough to kill a target.
Very long range: Final Spark is a laser with a huge range and short cooldown for an ultimate.
Lucent Singularity slows an area and reveals it, which zones and gives vision.
Prismatic Barrier shields allies twice, going out and back.
Strong burst: a landed Q into E, R and passive procs kills squishy targets.
weaknesses: Immobile: no dash or blink, so a dive kills her.
Damage depends on landing skillshots; a missed Q leaves her with no CC.
Light Binding can be blocked by minions and projectile blocks.
Weak against champions who can get to her quickly, such as assassins.

curve.lvl1: okay – E poke and passive auto attacks; not a strong all-in
curve.lvl2: good – Q root into E is a real kill threat with a jungler or ADC
curve.lvl3: good – full combo with W shield
curve.lvl6: strong – Final Spark extends her range and finishes kills
curve.items: medium – first item: Luden's Companion or Malignance gives burst and ultimate haste; Zhonya's Hourglass for safety
curve.late: good – stays a strong pick mage with long range

profile.curveNote: Lux wants Q and E to trade, and her kill threat jumps at 6 with Final Spark. Her power depends on landing Light Binding.
profile.waveClear: Good: E clears waves from range.
profile.sustain: Low: no healing; W shield only.

keyAbilities.trading: Q (Light Binding) root into E and R
keyAbilities.engage: E (Lucent Singularity) to poke and zone
keyAbilities.escape: W (Prismatic Barrier) shield on herself and allies
keyAbilities.answers: None. Lux has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Illumination: her damaging spells mark the target, and her next attack ignites it for bonus damage.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, stand behind minions, or block with a projectile block; Cleanse/QSS removes the root.
Q.notes: Light Binding: a missile that roots the first two enemies hit for 2 seconds.

W.notes: Prismatic Barrier: her wand shields allies on the way out and back.

E.answer: Walk out of the zone before it detonates.
E.notes: Lucent Singularity: a zone that slows and reveals, then detonates on recast or after 5 seconds.

R.notes: Final Spark: a long laser that hits all enemies in a line. Not a missile; wind walls do not stop it.

profile.windowAgainst: Lux's window is right after she misses Light Binding: walk up and all-in, because she has no other CC except E's slow and no escape.
checks: Does Lux land Q before using E and R?
Does Lux keep away from divers while Q is on cooldown?
Do enemies stand behind minions against Light Binding?
